description: Screening project economics for a utility-scale or distribution-scale solar project at a Texas point: energy from solar_revenue_estimate (NASA POWER irradiance, single-axis trackers by default, DC/AC 1.34), revenue either merchant (day-ahead capture price at the nearest ERCOT resource node over the last 24 months, 12 to 36, with ERCOT's curtailment proxy) or a flat PPA price you enter with an optional escalator, capex in USD per W-ac (default 1.40, NREL ATB utility-scale PV one-axis, moderate case, 2026 interpolated, 2022 dollars, excludes interconnection), fixed O&M per kW-ac-year (default 22, NREL ATB), degradation, land and interconnection costs you enter, an optional federal investment tax credit percent (default 0: under the 2025 tax law, solar that begins construction after 4 July 2026 does not qualify; projects that began earlier must be placed in service by the end of 2027), and a 30-year unlevered cash flow with simple payback and IRR. History, not a forecast. Use for 'what would a 100 MW solar farm here pencil to', 'solar IRR at this node', 'solar with a 35 dollar PPA'. Enterprise.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

cod_year.description: First operating year for the forward cases. Default next year.

curve.description: Name of a forward curve the account uploaded on the map; adds a custom case.

itc_pct.description: Federal ITC percent the project qualifies for. Default 0.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

months.description: Months of price history for merchant revenue, 12 to 36. Default 24.

ppa_escalator_pct.description: PPA escalator, percent per year. Default 0.

ppa_usd_per_mwh.description: Flat PPA price, USD per MWh (revenue_mode ppa).

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point for merchant pricing; irradiance still needs a location.

target_irr_pct.description: Target unlevered IRR for the PPA breakeven price. Default 8.

name: solar_economics
title: Solar project economics: energy, merchant or PPA revenue, costs, payback and IRR
